verdict.rationale: The evidence covers dependency scanning for known vulnerabilities, including transitive packages, but never mentions detecting dependency licenses or enforcing a license policy. Vulnerability scanning is an adjacent capability, not license compliance. License compliance is a fair axis for a DevSecOps platform with supply-chain scanning, so absence of evidence yields none, not na.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can detect the licenses of my dependencies and enforce a license policy in scans
